about.headline: Dr. Singh
about.body: After a decade owning and practicing at Menominee Falls Animal Hospital, Dr. Singh established Animal Care Hospital in Milwaukee — an independent practice focused on quality and compassion, not corporate volume. Clients regularly note that recommendations come with prices first, and that cats and dogs who are nervous still get patience from the full team.
